tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas/ sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa sel bar 'dod pas me dang*/ til dang*/ ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa mngon du byas shing*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ me'i phung po dang mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa'i thab khung dkar po zlum po'i dbus su/ ram̐ las ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bskyed nas/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐/ zhes brjod nas/ byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod rdzas dpag tu med par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab/ de nas thab kyi nang du/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ zhal gdangs shing rus pa dang rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bskyed la/ gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas de 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs pa la me tog la sogs pas mchod/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ me tog la sogs pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ badzra ḍā kā ya arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā la sogs pas mchod nas/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gros bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad snying gar bsdus pa kam̐ gi rnam pas sna sgo nas thon pa til la thim pas/ mi'i gzugs rid pa dang*/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du phul ba bdud rtsir gyur pa gsol bas mnyes par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing til dbul/ thog ma dang mtha' mar bhasmiṃ ku ru/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ grib ma'i nyes pa dang*/ nad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes spel tshig dang bcas pas dbul/ mthar snga ma bzhin du mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya/ bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ oṃ badzra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ thal ba chu bor dor bas chu la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don du 'gyur ro// tshul 'di nyid gzhan gyi don la dmigs te/

byas pas gzhan gyi don du yang 'gyur ro// za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga chos rje sa skya pa'i gdams pa 'phags pas yi ger bkod nas rgyal bu jim gyim la phul ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
